answer: Agents can limit fake identities by making each new account earn a slowly released reputation bond through independently verified work, with one bond per identity cluster allowed to vote or claim rewards. Peer audits compare behavior across accounts; linked clones lose their bond, so an attacker must lock up scarce value and risk forfeiture. A wharf ledger can track bonds, copper marks verified contributions, and a vine-like graph flags accounts that grow from the same roots.
